about: Workflows a push to feat-cmux-next starts that no pull request into it can reach (tests/test_ci_post_merge_checks.py). kind check: a verdict about the code, to move onto pull requests. kind publish: a deploy, a publish, a bot or a probe of a live system.

merge_tier.about: CI v2 merge tiers (cmuxterm-hq docs/rfd/0013-ci-v2.md). With switch on, merge_hold and next-autoland do not wait for a queued or running check of a post_merge workflow on a pull request into feat-cmux-next; a finished red of one still holds the merge. Each one also runs after the merge (after_merge), where the base-red watch names the owner of a red, who reverts or fixes forward. switch off: every check holds the merge until it finishes, as before. Switched on 2026-11-21 under Leo's "id rather we simply cut shit now and revisit later"; revert that one line to switch off.
